status: engineering prototype; not an efficacy protocol or approved training run
objective: Test whether predicted-region information can improve SAM2 without a good/bad-frame selector; compare against native SAM2 and matched region-shuffled and unlabelled controls.
author: CFBI IA_gate, BSD-3-Clause, external/CFBI at 91fc6a31b1752a8a9110b3ed480e05656f756691; the upstream gate is used unchanged.
adaptation: A shared zero-initialized 192-to-256 IA_gate scales each native memory cross-attention output using concatenated mean memory features for predicted background, foreground-interior and mixed-cell boundary. SAM2 memory keys, values, frame selection, pointer tokens and decoder remain native. The gate acts on the entire attention output, including the aggregate contribution from object pointers; it does not directly alter individual tokens.
regions: Existing Efficient-SAM2-derived mixed-cell rule applied to each actual stored low-resolution prediction. These are position labels, not claims of pure vector semantics. Group means do not retain within-region spatial structure.
controls: Regional assignment; deterministic per-memory-frame label permutation preserving each frame's counts; unlabelled global mean repeated three times. All use the same gate and parameter count. Native reference uses gate initialized to zero; generic uses only one distinct context vector and thus has different information content despite equal parameter count.
causality: Only memory actually read by native SAM2 and stored prior to the current frame; no post-prompt ground truth or future data for model inputs. Initial prompt is the dataset mask.
verification: Before any efficacy run: synthetic author/identity/gradient/control tests; real native-prediction plus state-hash parity and four layers for seq2/seq3; nonzero effect and verified gradient through frozen SAM2 on real data; confirm matched per-frame region counts, pointer handling and checkpoint reproducibility; full test suite. Zero gates are not evidence of trained-gate safety.
training_plan: Not frozen yet. Establish differentiable, frozen-SAM2 real-data training feasibility first. For evaluation use matched sequence-grouped splits, native trajectory comparison, full propagation and equal-sequence present Dice, Boundary F, false alarms and return events. PolypGen is development, not untouched confirmation; patient independence is not verified.
limitations: The aggregate memory-output gate is inspired by CFBI instance attention but is not CFBI regional matching. More parameters or outcomes on previously analysed sequences cannot establish reliable or novel improvement. Keep all failed and null outcomes.
